book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: Corintosha keranguemulachi Pablo' pilla kiika pallu

content: Jerusalén' chullachi ufeenda
Estennu keranguemu naatalala, Macedonia pruvinsiasha kerangue' vee vee mujtu waku wakudimulanu Dios naake ura' ke' keewaantsuñuba umaa wainnu tenve.
Yalaya naa tituba de-i' pullandu bain, yuj sunden dejuve, tsenmin naa yala pure deju' bain, tarukaaba kuwan tsa tsa deke', ufeenda lushi kuwa' esa putyu sunden kuwa kuwadekive.
Iren uwain yala naa naake kunu detya' tsa tsangue kumu deeñu bain entsana keenamuyu, tsejtu naa yala pure' kuwakenuu dejutyuve tenñu bain, kayu juntsanu pullake kumuwa deeve.
Tsejtu yai tenen tsanguendyatu, Cristonu keranguemulachi yalanu bain kuve'kaaka ti' patintsumu deeve.

Tsenmin yalaya lala' pensaya tsangui'chu deeve tenna juuba kayu dekidekiwa, tsaaren ajke' kilaya yalaren naa Bale Rukunu bain, naa lalanu bain ne ufeendaaba ju' kuwan tsa deiwa, Dios naadeisa tyañuba juntsa deitu.
Tsenñu' mityaa Titonu entsa tsamantsa aa ura' dekiñu, ya kaspelen ñulla' kejtsapala te'kandun dyamuñu, tsa mande ti' u'ta detiyu.

Ñullaya naa tichi bain ura' katawamu deeve, naa uwain tsaave tya' Diosnu keenguenchi bain, naa panchi bain, naa aseetanguenchi bain, naa tiba jeke kiike' kuwanchi bain, naa lala ñullanu estyamu deeñu bain,
tsangue keewaamu deju', ura' katawamu deeve; tsa' mitya naa lushi kuwanchi bain tsaren junuuya kidei.

Ñullanu ne entsanditu tsanguenbera kenu dejuve titundindyuyu, entsandimiya veelaa kuwandya' tyee kenu tya' ajchundyandetsuñuba ñui bain demijasa tenñaa tsandintsuyu, tsenmalaa ñulla uwain naa-i estyamu deju'ba tsangue keewaanu dejusa tenñu.
Ñulla mideeve lala' Bale Ruku Jesucristo mika ura ruku jutu, naa taruku ju' bain, ñulla' mityaren tsaa pure tiyaimuwaañuba, tsenmala ya juntsai' pure tiyaiñaa ñulla taruku tiyanudetsu.
Entsaatala jayu ñullanu aseetanguikare' ule' panu tenve; ñulla kaspee añuchi uwain tsanguenu tya', entsaa deke' peepumuwa deeve.
Tsa' mitya ñulla juntsa deke' dyadei, tsejtaa ñullaren nunbi jingue kenuu ju'ba tsanguenu ajchundya' keñu jumu deke' dyanu.
Main titi detanañuba juntsaya jayu nejuuve, ura balemiya tyee kuwakenuu ju' kuwandya' kuñuba juntsaa kayu baleve.
Entsanditu ne ñulla veelanu uraa kenu tya' tsa dekimee, ñullaa tiba tajtu lastemaa detiyasa tenñundindyuyu, tsa jutyu', pareju ura' dechusa tenñaa tsandintsuyu.

Challaya ñullaa yala tajtunu jumu detanave, tsaaren bene ñulla tajtunu jumaa yai bain tananu detsuve, tsenmin tiba pure' taa jumula bain mika meneste juu chumulanu kuwanuuya dejuve, tsenmalaa paree jujuunu detsuve,
juntsainmalaa matyu Diosa' Kiikanu fintsumi manánu laapu' patu naatiñuba juntsaa junutsu: Naa aa kamuchi bain laraiba indyu, naa jayun kakemuchi bain de-iiba indyuve,
ti' pillave.
Tito Corintosha erami.
Iya ñulla' mitya tyee kiikenu pensañuba naa Titonu bain juntsanguenu pensaren kekaañu' mitya, Diosnu yuj urave tintsuyu.
Tsenñu yaa iya naakesa tya' pañuba tsanguenu tiyave, tsenmin ya maaliren tsanguive'nu pensa' mitya, challa ñulla' junga keejanu juve.
Tsenmin main keranguemu naatalanu bain Titoba bulu eentsuyu. Yanaa nuka keranguen chumula bain laapu' patu uraa tene pamu deeve, Diosa' mika ura kuinda' mityan ti bain mika uraa kes neneiñu.

Tsenmin kerangue' vee vee mujtu waku wakudimu chachillaren yanu demi'ke' ka', laaba bulu neve'nu detireve veelanu kuwanu erentsumi lushi kavetes nenutsu, juntsangue' Bale Rukunaa balengure' keeware', naa yalanu bain lala uwain tsanguive'nu tyandaa tsanguendetsuñuba mijakaanu,
tsenmalaa kuwanutsumi lushi pure' sera dekiñuba lalanu na'baasa pai'nudetsu.
Tsaju' lalaya Bale Ruku' ajuushan deechu' kiiketyumujchi, naa ne chachilla' ajuusha bain tsaren deechu' katawainuuya kiikendetsuyu.

Tsenmin kamain keranguemu naatalanu bain yaiba bulu erendetsuyu; yaa tiba uwain naake kive'nu pensa ju'ba titala bain tsangue keewaamu juve, tsejtu umaa ñulla naakenu pa'ba uwain tsanguenu dejuve tenna ju' mityaa, kayu ajchundenna jantsuve.

Tsenmala Titonu laapu' panmalaya, Titoya ñuichi uraa kenu iba bulu taawasha kemu juve, tsenmala vejan keranguemu naatala pallu jumulaya engu kerangue' waku wakudimula' era chachi deju', yai bain Cristonu balenguremula deeve.
Tsa' mitya vejan kerangue' vee vee mujtu wa'dimu chachilla mijanudetsu, uwain jamulanu estya' keewaadei, tsenmalaa lala ñulla' mitya naati ura' pa' dajpamu deeñuba uwain juntsaa junutsu.

footnotes.text: 8.7 lala ñullanu estyamu deeñu bain tityumujchi, mantsa yumaa kiikalanuya entsa pillave: lalanu estyanchi bain.
